story.zh: 王允大摆寿宴，实则是要设计诛杀董卓，前往洛阳参加王允的寿宴。
story.en: Wang Yun hosts a lavish birthday banquet, though his true intent is to scheme and assassinate Dong Zhuo. Travel to Luoyang to attend Wang Yun's banquet.

forbidden.zh: 主角为王允、曹操、曹操亲属、李儒、董璜、董晏、董白、吕布、高顺、李傕、郭汜、华雄时无法触发
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Wang Yun, Cao Cao, a relative of Cao Cao, Li Ru, Dong Huang, Dong Yan, Dong Bai, Lu Bu, Gao Shun, Li Jue, Guo Si, or Hua Xiong

participate.zh: 【和王允的关系等级至少为1级】且【与董卓的关系等级不到2级】
participate.en: 【Relationship level with Wang Yun is at least Level 1】 and 【Relationship level with Dong Zhuo is less than Level 2】
